# Appliory — Comprehensive System & Knowledge Reference

> Canonical Domain: https://www.appliory.tech
> Platform Category: Privacy-First Document, PDF & Image Preparation Utilities

---

## 1. Executive Summary & Purpose

Appliory is an in-browser utility suite designed for students, job applicants, visa applicants, and professionals who need to verify, resize, compress, and check documents against strict submission guidelines without sacrificing privacy.

Unlike traditional cloud-based document converters (such as Smallpdf, iLovePDF, or TinyPNG) that upload user files to remote servers, Appliory processes 100% of files inside the user's local browser memory using modern Web APIs (HTML5 Canvas, PDF.js, and Web Cryptography API). Files are never transmitted across a network, guaranteeing total confidentiality for sensitive materials such as transcripts, passports, national identity cards, and financial statements.

---

## 2. Detailed Tool Specifications

### Tool 1: Image Compressor
- URL: https://www.appliory.tech/tools/image-compressor
- Supported Input Formats: JPEG, PNG, WebP
- Target Presets: 20 KB (Government job portals), 50 KB (Visa & passport submission portals), 100 KB (University admission systems), 200 KB (Standard portals), 500 KB (Email attachments)
- Custom Target Size: 1 KB to 25,000 KB
- Output Formats: JPEG, WebP
- Core Mechanism: Client-side HTML5 Canvas multi-pass iterative compression with quality optimization and dimension reduction. Includes live side-by-side visual preview and percentage reduction calculation.

### Tool 2: Image Resizer
- URL: https://www.appliory.tech/tools/image-resizer
- Supported Input Formats: JPEG, PNG, WebP
- Standard Presets: Passport Size (600x600 px), ID Photo (413x531 px), Square Avatar (800x800 px), Full HD (1920x1080 px)
- Features: Exact pixel dimension controls (width & height), aspect ratio lock toggle, format conversion (JPEG, PNG, WebP).
- Processing: Local Canvas resampling with Lanczos-equivalent high-quality interpolation.

### Tool 3: PDF to Excel Converter
- URL: https://www.appliory.tech/tools/pdf-to-excel
- Supported Format: PDF (.pdf)
- Features: 100% in-browser table extraction, configurable page ranges, coordinate-based row and column clustering, intelligent table cleanup (fill down grouped employee IDs, insert page context headers, deduplicate repeated headers, delete blank rows), cell editing, formula injection escaping, and OpenXML Excel (.xlsx) and RFC 4180 CSV export with leading zero preservation.
- Target Use Case: Confidential payroll records, multi-line invoices, ledger reports, and tabular PDF documents processed with zero server uploads.

### Tool 4: PDF Page Counter & Extractive Summary
- URL: https://www.appliory.tech/tools/pdf-page-counter
- Supported Format: PDF (.pdf)
- Features: Instant multi-file page count, extractable text page count vs scanned image page count, warning indicators for scanned pages requiring manual review.
- Extractive Summary Engine: Extracts actual sentences and structured headings directly from text layers with page references, allowing users to copy, download as TXT, or print as PDF summary.
- Processing: Mozilla PDF.js running entirely on-device via Web Workers.

### Tool 4: File Size Checker
- URL: https://www.appliory.tech/tools/file-size-checker
- Supported Formats: Any document or media file (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, JPG, PNG, ZIP, etc.)
- Features: Precise byte-level measurement, verification against custom application size limits in MB, visual badge indicators ("Within limit" vs "Exceeds limit").
- Measurement Standard: 1 MB = 1,048,576 bytes (binary standard) with exact byte breakdown.

### Tool 5: Duplicate File Finder
- URL: https://www.appliory.tech/tools/duplicate-file-finder
- Supported Formats: Any file type
- Verification Method: Cryptographic SHA-256 byte hashing via Web Cryptography API (`crypto.subtle.digest`).
- Guarantee: Detects byte-for-byte exact duplicates regardless of file name differences. Safe: does not auto-delete any user files.

### Tool 6: Full Document Application Checker
- URL: https://www.appliory.tech/tool
- Capabilities: Configurable checklist workspace for scholarship applications (Fulbright, Erasmus Mundus, Chevening, Commonwealth), university admissions, and employment packages.
- Rule Checks: Missing items, file signature verification (magic bytes), page count constraints, text readability, size limits, naming conventions, and duplicate detection.

---

## 3. Privacy, Architecture & Security Standards

1. Zero Cloud Transmissions: No server uploads, no temporary cloud storage, no cloud AI model scanning.
2. No Authentication Gate: No registration, login, cookies for tracking, or account creation required.
3. Volatile In-Memory Processing: Closing the browser tab instantly flushes all loaded documents from memory.
4. Content Security Policy: Strict CSP headers enforcing `'self'` execution and blocking third-party exfiltration.
